python3 -c "
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# 1. eps_difference: non-GAAP diluted EPS for Q4FY24 minus upper guidance bound
sql1 = '''SELECT f.amount - g.high AS eps_difference
FROM financials f
JOIN guidance g ON f.period_end = g.period_end 
    AND f.measure = g.measure 
    AND f.basis = g.basis 
    AND f.section_id = g.section_id
WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29'
  AND f.months = 3
  AND f.measure = 'Non-GAAP diluted net income per share'
  AND f.basis = 'non-GAAP'
  AND g.period_end = '2024-11-29'
  AND g.months = 3
  AND g.measure = 'Diluted EPS'
  AND g.basis = 'non-GAAP'
  AND g.issue_date = '2024-09-12';'''

for r in cur.execute(sql1):
    print('eps_difference:', r[0])

# 2. adjusted_operating_income
sql2 = '''SELECT f.amount AS adjusted_operating_income
FROM financials f
WHERE f.period_end = '2024-11-29'
  AND f.months = 3
  AND f.measure = 'Non-GAAP operating income'
  AND f.basis = 'non-GAAP';'''

for r in cur.execute(sql2):
    print('adjusted_operating_income:', r[0])

# 3. adjusted_margin
sql3 = '''SELECT (f_oi.amount / f_rev.amount) * 100.0 AS adjusted_margin
FROM financials f_oi
JOIN financials f_rev ON f_oi.period_end = f_rev.period_end 
  AND f_oi.months = f_rev.months
WHERE f_oi.period_end = '2024-11-29'
  AND f_oi.months = 3
  AND f_oi.measure = 'Non-GAAP operating income'
  AND f_oi.basis = 'non-GAAP'
  AND f_rev.measure = 'Total revenue'
  AND f_rev.basis = 'GAAP';'''

for r in cur.execute(sql3):
    print('adjusted_margin:', r[0])

# 4. margin_bridge
sql4 = '''SELECT ((f_oi.amount / f_rev.amount) - (f_gai.amount / f_rev.amount)) * 10000.0 AS margin_bridge
FROM financials f_oi
JOIN financials f_rev ON f_oi.period_end = f_rev.period_end 
  AND f_oi.months = f_rev.months
JOIN financials f_gai ON f_oi.period_end = f_gai.period_end
  AND f_oi.months = f_gai.months
WHERE f_oi.period_end = '2024-11-29'
  AND f_oi.months = 3
  AND f_oi.measure = 'Non-GAAP operating income'
  AND f_oi.basis = 'non-GAAP'
  AND f_rev.measure = 'Total revenue'
  AND f_rev.basis = 'GAAP'
  AND f_gai.measure = 'GAAP operating income'
  AND f_gai.basis = 'GAAP';'''

for r in cur.execute(sql4):
    print('margin_bridge:', r[0])

conn.close()
"
